Description:
Brand: SMC
PART NUMBER: ZP2V-AG1-10
DESCRIPTION: ZP2V, Vacuum Saving Valve
PROPERTIES/VALUES: Connection thread size for the pad: AG1 (G1/8, Male) Orifice Size: 10 (1.0 mm)
LONG DESCRIPTION: Machine builders using vacuum for handling or pick and place applications now have an energy saving option with our new Series ZP2V vacuum saving valve. Developed initially for the semiconductor market, these new valves are designed to shut down the suction line when any leakage is detected from the vacuum pad not being fully aligned with the work piece or even when the work piece is simply missing. By effectively stopping the air suction when the system recognizes any irregularities, the energy used in making this vacuum is kept to an absolute minimum. And, without the need for a work piece detection mechanism – which often use mechanical moving parts – those unwanted surface scratches or marks on the work piece are now a thing of the past.Ideal for use as either a stand-alone single vacuum pad or for multiple vacuum pad applications where the vacuum pressure loss is reduced to a minimum and the work piece remains held by the rest of the operating pads, ZP2V users will also save money and time by eliminating the need for expensive sensors or a programmable logic controller (PLC) plus dramatically reduced labour costs when altering the control circuit to accommodate a different shaped work piece.
BULLET POINTS: Connection thread size for the pad: M5, M6, M8, R1/8, G1/8, NPT1/8
  • Fixed orifice size (mm): 0.3, 0.5, 0.7, 1.0
  • Maximum operating pressure range (MPa): 0 to 0.7
  • Ambient and fluid temperature (°C): 5 to 60 (No freezing)
  • Element nominal filtration rating (µm): 40

Title: SMC ZP2V-A5-05 VALVE Incl VAT
Description:
Brand: SMC
PART NUMBER: ZP2V-A5-05
DESCRIPTION: ZP2V, Vacuum Saving Valve
PROPERTIES/VALUES: Connection thread size for the pad: A5 (M5, Male) Orifice Size: 05 (0.5 mm)
LONG DESCRIPTION: Machine builders using vacuum for handling or pick and place applications now have an energy saving option with our new Series ZP2V vacuum saving valve. Developed initially for the semiconductor market, these new valves are designed to shut down the suction line when any leakage is detected from the vacuum pad not being fully aligned with the work piece or even when the work piece is simply missing. By effectively stopping the air suction when the system recognizes any irregularities, the energy used in making this vacuum is kept to an absolute minimum. And, without the need for a work piece detection mechanism – which often use mechanical moving parts – those unwanted surface scratches or marks on the work piece are now a thing of the past.Ideal for use as either a stand-alone single vacuum pad or for multiple vacuum pad applications where the vacuum pressure loss is reduced to a minimum and the work piece remains held by the rest of the operating pads, ZP2V users will also save money and time by eliminating the need for expensive sensors or a programmable logic controller (PLC) plus dramatically reduced labour costs when altering the control circuit to accommodate a different shaped work piece.
BULLET POINTS: Connection thread size for the pad: M5, M6, M8, R1/8, G1/8, NPT1/8
  • Fixed orifice size (mm): 0.3, 0.5, 0.7, 1.0
  • Maximum operating pressure range (MPa): 0 to 0.7
  • Ambient and fluid temperature (°C): 5 to 60 (No freezing)
  • Element nominal filtration rating (µm): 40

Title: SMC ZP2V-A01-05 VALVE Incl VAT
Description:
Brand: SMC
PART NUMBER: ZP2V-A01-05
DESCRIPTION: ZP2V, Vacuum Saving Valve
PROPERTIES/VALUES: Connection thread size for the pad: A01 (Male Female: Rc1/8 ) Orifice Size: 05 (0.5 mm)
LONG DESCRIPTION: Machine builders using vacuum for handling or pick and place applications now have an energy saving option with our new Series ZP2V vacuum saving valve. Developed initially for the semiconductor market, these new valves are designed to shut down the suction line when any leakage is detected from the vacuum pad not being fully aligned with the work piece or even when the work piece is simply missing. By effectively stopping the air suction when the system recognizes any irregularities, the energy used in making this vacuum is kept to an absolute minimum. And, without the need for a work piece detection mechanism – which often use mechanical moving parts – those unwanted surface scratches or marks on the work piece are now a thing of the past.Ideal for use as either a stand-alone single vacuum pad or for multiple vacuum pad applications where the vacuum pressure loss is reduced to a minimum and the work piece remains held by the rest of the operating pads, ZP2V users will also save money and time by eliminating the need for expensive sensors or a programmable logic controller (PLC) plus dramatically reduced labour costs when altering the control circuit to accommodate a different shaped work piece.
BULLET POINTS: Connection thread size for the pad: M5, M6, M8, R1/8, G1/8, NPT1/8

  • Maximum operating pressure range (MPa): 0 to 0.7
  • Ambient and fluid temperature (°C): 5 to 60 (No freezing)
  • Element nominal filtration rating (µm): 40

LONG DESCRIPTION: We have upgraded our long life 2/3 port mechanical valve, VM 100/200 Series that has been redesigned with simplicity in mind. Brighter in appearance, the VM100/200 can withstand harsh operating conditions, demonstrating an ongoing commitment to refine our products. The series' lightweight and compact design, delivers both cost and space savings. It has four mounting variations, two piping options and several types of actuators that can be easily interchanged and/or replaced. Visual control has been simplified thanks to colourful push button and twist selector options; plus a small, visual indicator on the VM100 bottom ported model also makes maintenance checks easier to perform. Suitable for a wide range of applications, including vacuum, the VM 100/200 is ideal for pneumatic control panels and confirming the position of a workpiece using a pneumatic signal.

Title: SMC SY3300R-5U1 VALVE Incl VAT
Description:
Brand: SMC
PART NUMBER: SY3300R-5U1
DESCRIPTION: SY3000, 5 Port Solenoid Valve, All Types (New Product)
PROPERTIES/VALUES: Actuation: 3 (3 Position Closed Centre) Mounting/Porting: 0 (Base Mounted) Seal: 0 (Rubber) Pilot Specification: R (External Pilot) Back Pressure Check Valve: None Pilot Valve: Standard (0.7MPa) Coil specification: Standard Rated Voltage: 5 (24VDC) Light/Surge Suppressor/Common Specification: U (w/Light/Surge Voltage Suppressor, Non-polar) Manual Override: Non-locking Push Type A B Port Size: Base Mounted Valve Thread: Rc (or No Selection in the Case of M5 or One-touch Fittings) Mounting Option: Mounting Screw, Round Head Combination Screw Made to Order: None
LONG DESCRIPTION: When our R&D engineers redesigned our popular SY 5 port solenoid range, they had one objective - to develop an all purpose solenoid valve range offering impressive functionality. The result is our new Series SY3000/5000. Extremely compact but with outstanding flow rate performance - up to 80% higher than our previous SY models - our new SY range can now operate faster with reduced cycle times.
